name: route-price
description: Route and price for the two OPEN rows. The atlas's own discipline lets OPEN rows quote no numbers — what they owe instead is a route with falsifiers and prices with derivations. This repo is that debt, paid: one dossier per OPEN row (dtc-clock, choice-primitive), each with certificate criteria, milestones that name their own failure mode, and price lines whose arithmetic is re-derived by executable witnesses (the Landauer floor with ln2 re-derived by quadrature and k the exact SI constant; the choice-primitive toy — coherent branching with engineered invariance versus random programs, the no-cloning wall executed as a rephasing-covariance separation, and the certification toll re-invoiced from the epoch-3 postselection ledger). The checker refuses any dossier that claims settledness — the only verdict this repo can express is OPEN-ROUTE; a milestone without a price, a milestone without a falsifier, or a citation that does not resolve all fail the build.
